scope: Owned companion runtime in the controlled development Gromp encounter: following, combat/healing, feeding, earned Smite evolution and saved source-rig playback. Production purchases, final item passives and jungle roles remain unfinished.

sourcePreparation.conversion: Original DDS decoded to RGBA PNG with Pillow. No painted or generated image content.
sourcePreparation.upgradeScalars: Derived from the pinned standard Smite DataValues and all three final castRadius arrays; source float32 0.20000000298023224 is normalized to the local 0.2 slow policy.

policies.actor: Separate owned state, not a neutral Unit: no targetability, bounty, collision body or vision source.
policies.sourceCalculations: DPS 20–150 level interpolation +0.1 bonus AD +0.16 AP +0.04 bonus HP +0.25 bonus armor/MR. HPS six through level three, then two more per level. Enum bindings and delivery are local adapters.
policies.localRecovery: min(250,70+20*level) times missing-health fraction; (15+4*level) times missing-mana fraction times 2.25. Energy not modeled.
policies.feeds: Large/epic last hits feed one, or two while consuming a bonus treat and granting 20 gold; capped at 35. Medium/small kills do not feed.
policies.rewards: Retained controller 80 XP per qualifying kill plus 150 first-monster XP. Native lifecycle/credit/area and post-quest modifiers remain unverified.
policies.forms: Local Baby until 35 feeds, then Adult. Authored initial-hidden Baby is not native growth dispatch evidence.
policies.death: Owner death hides the rig and clears target/release/path; feed and bonus clocks persist.
policies.counterConflict: Source TotalCounters=35 and Breakpoint1=20 versus published first-evolution 15 kills. Adapter uses 15/35 earned feeds; native remaining/fed interpretation is unproven.

coverage: All variants follow and continue exact movement/path/pose state.
Bonus-stat DPS and HPS breakpoint; outgoing/incoming category boundaries.

Source-tag feeding, first-monster XP, bonus consumption, capped sequential phase clocks and earned 15/35 stages.
Champion Smite damage and independent saved slow; final area damage spends one charge.
Original rig/clip digests and DATA archive icon bytes/PNG signatures.
initialFindings: Follow target refresh tightened from 30 to 12 ticks after a genuine lag test failure.
Champion damage expectation now accounts for same-tick ordinary Lux regeneration and separately verifies the exact 40-damage event.

browser.regressionCommand: npx playwright test e2e/owned-companions.spec.ts e2e/smite.spec.ts e2e/neutral-gromp.spec.ts e2e/garen-player.spec.ts e2e/saves.spec.ts --reporter=line
assertions: Real right-click movement/attack starts the companion commitment; pending strike reloads exactly and delivers healing/damage.
Real F base Smite spends a charge; owner death hides the rig, clears commitments and reloads exactly.
All three variants feed through 15/35 actual spawned large-monster deaths, rather than direct feed assignment.
Exact first/full transform, champion-slow and final-area checkpoints.
Real F hits a champion for a 40-damage event with saved Smite slow.
Practice reset readies the final real F area cast; primary/near/far HP is exactly 600/600/2000 with one charge spent.
Correct source icons and HUD progress; only the selected companion GLB loads.
Each Baby/Adult form contributes GPU pixels and has no neutral Unit.
initialFindings: Movement test initially sampled before settling and compared a displacement that could remain small after a turn changed the trailing offset. It now waits for the actual trailing destination and uses movement that separates the positions.
A first combat setup moved beyond the local Gromp leash; reset correctly cancelled the pet strike. Final setup stays inside the leash.
Diagnostic wolf spawning needed its source rig loaded before rendering; the test now loads that model explicitly.
browser.limits: Fixture setup, monster stun/health preparation, repeated lethal feed targets and isolated release stepping are diagnostic. Not a natural jungle clear, full browser audit, full-match/performance test or native comparison.

assets.scope: All GLBs and map; navigation hash checked.

production.warning: Existing chunks above 500 KB warning remains.
